blocks.en: Let the functions $a_{ij}^k$ and $b_i$ be real analytic at the origin of $\mathbb{R}^{N+n-1}$. Then the system \eqref{eq:ck-quasilinear-system} with initial conditions \eqref{eq:ck-zero-initial-data} has a unique (among real analytic functions) system of solutions $u_i$ that is real analytic at the origin.
blocks.zh: 设函数 $a_{ij}^k$ 和 $b_i$ 在 $\mathbb{R}^{N+n-1}$ 的原点处实解析. 那么, 方程组 \eqref{eq:ck-quasilinear-system} 配以初始条件 \eqref{eq:ck-zero-initial-data}, 具有在原点处实解析的解组 $u_i$, 且该解组在实解析函数类中唯一.

blocks.en: Proceeding in a similar fashion, we can compute derivatives of all orders. The resulting expression for any derivative of $u_i$ at the origin is a polynomial with positive coefficients involving derivatives of $a_{ij}^k$ and $b_i$ at the origin.
blocks.zh: 类似地进行下去, 可以计算各阶导数. $u_i$ 在原点处的任意导数的表达式, 都是由 $a_{ij}^k$ 和 $b_i$ 在原点处的导数组成的正系数多项式.

blocks.en: The theorem guarantees the existence of a solution in a neighborhood of each point on the initial surface. By taking the union of all these neighborhoods, we obtain the existence of a solution in an open set containing the initial surface. We also note that the Taylor series for the solution is guaranteed to converge in a ball whose radius depends only on $n$, $N$, $M$, and $r$.
blocks.zh: 这一定理保证, 初始曲面的每一点的某个邻域内都存在解. 取所有这些邻域的并, 就得到在包含初始曲面的一个开集内存在解. 还要注意, 解的 Taylor 级数保证在某个球内收敛, 球的半径只依赖于 $n$, $N$, $M$ 和 $r$.

blocks.en: We emphasize that the theorem is strictly local in character, that is, the solution may cease to exist or at least lose analyticity at some finite value of $x_n$. We shall see examples of this later when we study development of shocks. Also, the theorem does not rule out the existence of nonanalytic solutions even in a neighborhood of the initial surface. Uniqueness is only guaranteed within the class of analytic functions. Holmgren's theorem, proved in the next section, asserts that for linear equations the analytic solution is unique in a larger function class.
blocks.zh: 强调, 这一定理具有严格的局部性质, 即解可能在 $x_n$ 的某个有限值处不再存在, 或至少失去解析性. 后面研究激波形成时, 将看到这方面的例子. 此外, 即使在初始曲面的一个邻域内, 这一定理也不排除非解析解的存在. 唯一性只在解析函数类中得到保证. 下一节将证明的 Holmgren 定理断言, 对线性方程, 解析解在一个更大的函数类中也是唯一的.
